WebGL Fluid Simulation by Pavel Dobryakov
https://github.com/PavelDoGreat/WebGL-Fluid-Simulation
Upstream commit a2d292931f19d9b3b9f564e23e6c32729d2121c3
MIT license. See fluid-LICENSE.txt and fluid-PROVENANCE.txt.
The solver is adapted for transparent Chinese ink, continuous flow and pen interaction.
Site-specific retained brush pigment holds its shape before releasing into wet ink.
Brush input, shared brush geometry, stroke replay, scoring and object-icon UI
are local code. Live strokes and demonstrations use dist/brush.js.

Hanzi Writer Data / Make Me a Hanzi
https://github.com/chanind/hanzi-writer-data
The unmodified character outlines and medians in data/ai.json, data/da.json,
data/model-*.json, data/word-*.json and data/name-*.json use the Arphic Public License.
See ARPHICPL.TXT and hanzi-PROVENANCE.txt for the full source mapping.
No Hanzi Writer JavaScript library is bundled.

Teaching presentation references (no images or text copied):
https://www.moe.gov.cn/srcsite/A26/s8001/201301/t20130125_147389.html
https://yuwei.usts.edu.cn/info/1017/1266.htm
Source medians and layout come from font-derived regular-script models.
Visible strokes are generated by the same brush used for live handwriting;
font outlines are not used as an unachievable final silhouette. These are not
historical calligraphy facsimiles.

The source drawing was supplied by the user.
The 1975 Scanimate/CAESAR demo reel is a motion-design reference.
https://mediaburn.org/videos/scanimate-caesar-demo/
The motion is implemented in the site's own Canvas code.

The introductory yellow/green vortex in dist/vortex.js is original project code.
Visual/technical references: https://github.com/Azkun/balatroShader and
https://reactbits.dev/backgrounds/balatro . No original game shader or
third-party shader source is bundled. See vortex-PROVENANCE.txt.
